'''Rellu''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that was one of [[Tarro Blood]]'s followers, along with [[Sedyn Kyne]]. Rellu, Kyne, and a number of other Mandalorians met on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Hunter (individual)|Blood's rival]], but their entire group was killed in the resultant firefight with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Hedarr Soongh]].<ref name="TOR:HR" />
